successCriteria.description: The exported function ResourcePrefix(value string) (string, bool) exists in internal/id/resource.go and returns (prefix, true) when value matches one of the seven Prefix* constants via HasResourceShape, and ("", false) otherwise.

Table-driven tests in internal/id/resource_test.go cover: a valid ID for each of the seven prefixes, an unknown prefix, a value one hex character too short, a value with uppercase hex, and the empty string — each asserting the expected (prefix, ok) tuple.
All existing tests in internal/id/resource_test.go continue to pass after the change (no regression in HasResourceShape, Resource, KeyPair, VPC, Subnet, or NetworkInterface).
make lint test passes with no errors or warnings.

constraints: ResourcePrefix must reuse HasResourceShape and the existing Prefix* constants for all shape validation — no new validation logic may be introduced.
No new files, no new dependencies, and no changes to any existing function signatures, call sites, or exported API surface beyond the addition of ResourcePrefix.
Tests must be table-driven, live in the id_test package in resource_test.go, and follow the same t.Parallel() and subtest pattern as existing tests.
No CGO may be introduced; the build must remain compatible with CGO_ENABLED=0.
outOfScope: Any API endpoint, handler, or route that uses ResourcePrefix — this phase adds only the utility function and its tests.
Any service-layer integration, refactoring of HasResourceShape, or changes to existing function behavior or call sites.
Adding new resource types or Prefix* constants beyond the seven already declared.

entityInvariants.invariant: ResourcePrefix must correctly identify the prefix of any valid resource ID by delegating exclusively to HasResourceShape and the seven existing Prefix* constants; it must return ("", false) for any value that does not match all seven.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — pure utility function, no authentication required
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns ("", false) on no match rather than an error value; the bool return is the sole indicator of success/failure

consistencyRequirements.requirement: ResourcePrefix must iterate the seven Prefix* constants in the same order they are declared in resource.go and delegate shape validation to HasResourceShape — the exact same validation logic already in HasResourceShape must be reused, not reimplemented.
Tests must follow the same table-driven pattern, t.Parallel() usage, and subtest naming convention as the existing TestHasResourceShape and TestResource tests in resource_test.go.
The id_test package import path and test file naming must remain consistent with the existing Go module github.com/ahmedmohamedut/kumo/internal/id.
